paragraphs.text: Now in the things which we are saying the chief point [is this]: We have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
paragraphs.original: Κεφάλαιον δὲ ἐπὶ τοῖς λεγομένοις, τοιοῦτον ἔχομεν ἀρχιερέα, ὃς ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ θρόνου τῆς μεγαλωσύνης ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς,
paragraphs.translit: Kephalaion de epi tois legomenois, toiouton echomen archierea, hos ekathisen en dexia tou thronou tēs megalōsynēs en tois ouranois,

paragraphs.text: a minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, not man.
paragraphs.original: τῶν ἁγίων λειτουργὸς καὶ τῆς σκηνῆς τῆς ἀληθινῆς, ἣν ἔπηξεν ὁ κύριος, οὐκ ἄνθρωπος.
paragraphs.translit: tōn hagiōn leitourgos kai tēs skēnēs tēs alēthinēs, hēn epēxen ho kyrios, ouk anthrōpos.

paragraphs.text: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is necessary that this [high priest] also have somewhat to offer.
paragraphs.original: πᾶς γὰρ ἀρχιερεὺς εἰς τὸ προσφέρειν δῶρά τε καὶ θυσίας καθίσταται· ὅθεν ἀναγκαῖον ἔχειν τι καὶ τοῦτον ὃ προσενέγκῃ.
paragraphs.translit: pas gar archiereus eis to prospherein dōra te kai thysias kathistatai· hothen anankaion echein ti kai touton ho prosenenkē.

paragraphs.text: Now if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are those who offer the gifts according to the law;
paragraphs.original: εἰ μὲν οὖν ἦν ἐπὶ γῆς, οὐδʼ ἂν ἦν ἱερεύς, ὄντων τῶν προσφερόντων κατὰ νόμον τὰ δῶρα·
paragraphs.translit: ei men oun ēn epi gēs, oudʼ an ēn hiereus, ontōn tōn prospherontōn kata nomon ta dōra·

paragraphs.text: who serve [that which is] a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses is warned [of God] when he is about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern that was showed thee in the mount.
paragraphs.original: (οἵτινες ὑποδείγματι καὶ σκιᾷ λατρεύουσιν τῶν ἐπουρανίων, καθὼς κεχρημάτισται Μωϋσῆς μέλλων ἐπιτελεῖν τὴν σκηνήν, Ὅρα γάρ, φησίν, ποιήσεις πάντα κατὰ τὸν τύπον τὸν δειχθέντα σοι ἐν τῷ ὄρει)·
paragraphs.translit: (hoitines hypodeigmati kai skia latreuousin tōn epouraniōn, kathōs kechrēmatistai Mōysēs mellōn epitelein tēn skēnēn, Hora gar, phēsin, poiēseis panta kata ton typon ton deichthenta soi en tō orei)·

paragraphs.text: But now hath he obtained a ministry the more excellent, by so much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which hath been enacted upon better promises.
paragraphs.original: νυνὶ δὲ διαφορωτέρας τέτυχεν λειτουργίας, ὅσῳ καὶ κρείττονός ἐστιν διαθήκης μεσίτης, ἥτις ἐπὶ κρείττοσιν ἐπαγγελίαις νενομοθέτηται.
paragraphs.translit: nyni de diaphorōteras tetychen leitourgias, hosō kai kreittonos estin diathēkēs mesitēs, hētis epi kreittosin epangeliais nenomothetētai.

paragraphs.text: For if that first [covenant] had been faultless, then would no place have been sought for a second.
paragraphs.original: Εἰ γὰρ ἡ πρώτη ἐκείνη ἦν ἄμεμπτος, οὐκ ἂν δευτέρας ἐζητεῖτο τόπος·
paragraphs.translit: Ei gar hē prōtē ekeinē ēn amemptos, ouk an deuteras ezēteito topos·

paragraphs.text: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, That I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and       with the house of Judah;
paragraphs.original: μεμφόμενος γὰρ αὐτοὺς λέγει· Ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται, λέγει κύριος, καὶ συντελέσω ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰούδα διαθήκην καινήν,
paragraphs.translit: memphomenos gar autous legei· Idou hēmerai erchontai, legei kyrios, kai syntelesō epi ton oikon Israēl kai epi ton oikon Iouda diathēkēn kainēn,

paragraphs.text: Not according to the covenant that I made with their       fathers In the day that I took them by the hand to lead them forth out       of the land of Egypt; For they continued not in my covenant, And I regarded them not, saith the Lord.
paragraphs.original: οὐ κατὰ τὴν διαθήκην ἣν ἐποίησα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπιλαβομένου μου τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν ἐξαγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου, ὅτι αὐτοὶ οὐκ ἐνέμειναν ἐν τῇ διαθήκῃ μου, κἀγὼ ἠμέλησα αὐτῶν, λέγει κύριος.
paragraphs.translit: ou kata tēn diathēkēn hēn epoiēsa tois patrasin autōn en hēmera epilabomenou mou tēs cheiros autōn exagagein autous ek gēs Aigyptou, hoti autoi ouk enemeinan en tē diathēkē mou, kagō ēmelēsa autōn, legei kyrios.

paragraphs.text: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house       of Israel After those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, And on their heart also will I write them: And I will be to them a God, And they shall be to me a people:
paragraphs.original: ὅτι αὕτη ἡ διαθήκη ἣν διαθήσομαι τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰσραὴλ μετὰ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐκείνας, λέγει κύριος, διδοὺς νόμους μου εἰς τὴν διάνοιαν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐπὶ καρδίας αὐτῶν ἐπιγράψω αὐτούς, καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς εἰς θεόν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαόν.
paragraphs.translit: hoti hautē hē diathēkē hēn diathēsomai tō oikō Israēl meta tas hēmeras ekeinas, legei kyrios, didous nomous mou eis tēn dianoian autōn, kai epi kardias autōn epigrapsō autous, kai esomai autois eis theon kai autoi esontai moi eis laon.

paragraphs.text: And they shall not teach every man his fellow-citizen, And every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: For all shall know me, From the least to the greatest of them.
paragraphs.original: καὶ οὐ μὴ διδάξωσιν ἕκαστος τὸν πολίτην αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕκαστος τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, λέγων· Γνῶθι τὸν κύριον, ὅτι πάντες εἰδήσουσίν με ἀπὸ μικροῦ ἕως μεγάλου αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: kai ou mē didaxōsin hekastos ton politēn autou kai hekastos ton adelphon autou, legōn· Gnōthi ton kyrion, hoti pantes eidēsousin me apo mikrou heōs megalou autōn.

paragraphs.text: For I will be merciful to their iniquities, And their sins will I remember no more.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι ἵλεως ἔσομαι ταῖς ἀδικίαις αὐτῶν, καὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ μνησθῶ ἔτι.
paragraphs.translit: hoti hileōs esomai tais adikiais autōn, kai tōn hamartiōn autōn ou mē mnēsthō eti.

paragraphs.text: In that he saith, A new [covenant] he hath made the first old. But that which is becoming old and waxeth aged is nigh unto vanishing away.
paragraphs.original: ἐν τῷ λέγειν Καινὴν πεπαλαίωκεν τὴν πρώτην, τὸ δὲ παλαιούμενον καὶ γηράσκον ἐγγὺς ἀφανισμοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: en tō legein Kainēn pepalaiōken tēn prōtēn, to de palaioumenon kai gēraskon engys aphanismou.
